criterion_or_note: Nursing Levels of Care
Handwritten numbers above level columns

These guidelines are meant to provide parameters for standardization. Multiple line items can increase the level of care depending on the nursing interventions 
required as well as state regulation criteria. Documentation is a critical component. Hyperbilirubinemia should resolve within 5 days. Subset is for 4 day LOS from 
hyperbilirubinemia identified/admitted Completed 7/15/24.
